meta.coords: reference pixels, x right, y down, origin top-left of the 1254x1254 file
meta.unit: D = body (perforated tube) outer diameter; H = height above the bottom contact line
meta.scripts: WorkFiles/flashbang/metrology/fb_m*.py (Blender 5.2 headless + NumPy); debug images in metrology/debug

layout.background_note: dark neutral grey studio sweep, slightly lighter toward the top-right, soft contact shadow under each object; bottom panels have a 1-2 px light frame

unit.note: v1/v4 read 2.0%/3.5% wider than v2/v3 with no matching height change: off-axis perspective widening of a cylinder, not a size change. 175.31 px (v2/v3) is the true D at the object depth.

camera_estimate_top_row.elevation: camera roughly level with the lower ring line (H ~1.2 D): circles above it are seen from below (the sleeve step bows UP 4-5 px at the centre), the base-cap bottom is seen from above (bows DOWN 4-5 px)
camera_estimate_top_row.evidence: (a) width growth of the off-centre views, (b) sag of the ring lines / sleeve step / cap bottom, (c) the ring read face-on in v1 is 3% taller than edge-on in v2-v4. All weak. Heights are given raw (orthographic reading) and perspective-corrected with this camera; they differ by up to 3.5% at mid-body (row A 2.23 vs 2.16 D). Use the corrected set and confirm by overlaying a render from this camera on the registered crops.

body.note: constant from the sleeve step to the cap: v2 174.95/174.76/175.03 px at three heights, v3 175.72/175.42/176.00

sleeve_top_band.note: solid band above hole row A, proud of the body by 0.033 D radially; small chamfers top and bottom

sleeve_top_chamfer_top_edge.note: approx; chamfer ~0.063 D radial x 0.075 D tall, paint worn to bare steel on it

base_cap_side.note: reads as a 12-flat polygon: faint vertical facet lines ~30 deg apart in v2 (x 420, 470, 507, 548) and polygonal kinks on the top chamfer edge; flats with soft corners

foot_bottom_edge.note: lower chamfer from the cap side in to the foot (v2); rough +-0.03

collar_disc.note: round steel disc, chamfered top edge

neck_under_collar.note: thin dark gap between the collar disc and the sleeve chamfer

inner_brass_tube.note: its limb is visible inside the side holes: v2 r=64.5 px, v3 r=67.9 px

outer_wall_thickness.note: cut face of each hole visible (lit, 5-9 px) on the side holes

outline_measured_v2_front.note: paint-edge outline (includes the thin bare-steel rim). Holes are slightly TALL ovals, not circles: w/h 0.85-0.88 in v2, v3 and the p4 close-up

holes.angular_width_note: 41-42 deg raw, 40 deg after the front-surface perspective correction

per_view_hole_azimuths.format: [x_left, x_right, az_left_deg, az_right_deg] per visible hole, 0 = toward camera, + = right; -90/90 = clipped at the limb

holes.count_per_row: NOT self-consistent across views. v2 and v3 show a 60-63 deg pitch (narrow ~20 deg webs); v1 and v4 each show one ~50 deg web (hole pitch 87-97 deg). Hole centres per view (deg): v1 -61, 36.5 | v2 -61, 1.4, 63 | v3 -52, 11, 77 | v4 -67, 20, 87.

candidate_patterns.name: 5 holes, two wide webs
candidate_patterns.fits: every view's local spacing (v2/v3 60-deg pairs, v1 97-deg gap, v4 87 then 67)

candidate_patterns.name: 6 holes even
candidate_patterns.fits: v2, v3 and p2 only; v1 and v4 would show an extra front hole where the reference shows paint

candidate_patterns.name: 5 holes even
candidate_patterns.fits: the average spacing only; off by 10-25 deg in every view

holes.rim: every hole edge has a thin bare-steel rim (paint chipped); the cut wall is visible on the side holes

inner_seam.where: one circumferential seam line on the inner brass tube at each hole-row centre height (0-3 px above the centre)

ring_lines.type: thin engraved groove with a light upper lip: 2-3 px dark line (0.012-0.017 D); paint worn along it
ring_lines.plus: the sleeve-bottom step (H ~2.62 D) reads as a third, stronger line

housing_box.note: v2 face 82 px (0.46 D after perspective); v3 shows two faces 57+70 px -> side 90 px (0.52 D) at ~39 deg yaw

top_cover_plate.note: plate over the box top; on the side away from the pin it extends as an arm ending in a small curl with a cross pin (v1 x75-118, v3 x679-692, v4 x1013-1035); overhang length differs per view

hinge_knuckle.axis: horizontal, parallel to the lever face
hinge_knuckle.where: top edge of the lever-side face; the lever top curls round it (v2: x 442-500, y 45-69)

pin_boss.axis: horizontal, 90 deg from the lever normal (see pin_vs_lever)
pin_boss.where: upper corner of the housing beside the knuckle, centre at H ~3.61 D raw

small_round_boss_on_face.where: upper corner of a housing face near the top plate (v1 x185 y63, v3 x802 y68); v3 also shows a spiral/slotted screw head of similar size at x760 y67

fuze_head.pin_vs_lever: in v1, v2 and v4 the pin axis is 90 deg from the lever normal (v2: lever at the back, pin points right; v4: lever front-right, pin front-left; v1: lever right, pin toward the viewer). v3 does not agree.

wire.v1: reads as TWO parallel strands (split-ring style), each ~0.022 D, pair ~0.06 D

pull_ring.hangs_from: the pin eye at H ~3.6 D; ring top ~H 3.65 D, bottom ~H 2.6-2.7 D (about the sleeve-bottom step)

lever.top: curls over the hinge knuckle at the housing top (H ~3.83 raw)

upper_segment.note: v4: hugs the housing face, tapers from 72 px to 50 px (left edge slanted, right edge vertical)

joggle.note: v4 y 138-143: the lower segment steps outward (rounded top corner) to clear the collar and sleeve

lower_segment.note: flat face; the visible side band (8 px in v4, 15 px in v1, 10 px in v3) is either a thick plate (~0.05 D) or a shallow side flange; not resolvable

tip.shape: squared end with rounded corners r~0.05 D; in v1 the last ~0.1 D bends inward toward the body (the bent tip); v3 shows only a rounded corner

per_view_rows_ref_px.note: auto from the silhouette; above those rows the ring overlaps; the v3 left edge is the body limb (lever partly behind the body)

end_face.structure: flat outer annulus -> raised rim lip at the outer edge -> narrow recessed groove -> central disc (about flush with the rim)
end_face.note: notches are rectangular cuts through the rim lip, each with a matching step on the disc edge; the side views v1 and v3 instead show one wide recess in the foot (58-68 deg of arc) - inconsistent with the close-up

outlines.note: Moore trace of the cleaned silhouette, Douglas-Peucker 0.8 px; ring interiors are not part of the outer outline; below y 690 clipped to the cap width to drop the floor shadow

v1.mapping: reg_x = 220 + (ref_x - body_centre_x)*scale ; reg_y = 790 + (ref_y - bottom_y)*scale ; D = 200 px, bottom contact at row 790

v2.mapping: reg_x = 220 + (ref_x - body_centre_x)*scale ; reg_y = 790 + (ref_y - bottom_y)*scale ; D = 200 px, bottom contact at row 790

v3.mapping: reg_x = 220 + (ref_x - body_centre_x)*scale ; reg_y = 790 + (ref_y - bottom_y)*scale ; D = 200 px, bottom contact at row 790

v4.mapping: reg_x = 220 + (ref_x - body_centre_x)*scale ; reg_y = 790 + (ref_y - bottom_y)*scale ; D = 200 px, bottom contact at row 790
